explanation: Fires only at GO when the agent chooses a2 and the previous trial was rewarded (always 0 at D1, at D2, when choosing a1, and 0-1 at GO after an unrewarded trial): it is about 9-10 early in the episode (trials 3-16), about 4 on the first rewarded trial after a loss, and weaker later in the episode (about 6-8 near trials 25-47, 2-3 after trial 60, 0 after trial 85). It builds up and stays high over a run of rewarded a2 trials, whether the transitions were common or rare.
